correctness.rationale: Branches are exactly degree-n-1 vertices (n>=4); all automorphisms arise from S_n. The marked support graph enforces pointwise stabilizer C2^p x S_u. Distances shorter than L from all marks distinguish its branch orbits at round L-1. Distances shorter than L from each stabilized branch color class recover the edge-orbit type within another L-1 rounds. Cross-class and folded same-class paths yield the exact class counts and sizes. Direct WL versus explicit automorphism enumeration plus full class-size checks succeeded for 12424 cases; finite tests are only corroboration.

value.rationale: The theorem classifies all marked orbit partitions for a two-parameter natural family of clique subdivisions, provides a nontrivial uniform depth bound independent of clique size and marker number, and gives a closed orbit-count formula and every class size. This quantifies the effect of arbitrary marked path positions and independent reflection symmetries, with direct applications to the behavior of individualization-refinement on structured highly cyclic graphs.
